knownIssuesInspected.title: Mark to base bug
knownIssuesInspected.finding: Defect confirmed but the issue names the wrong codepoint. U+FE74 (ARABIC KASRATAN ISOLATED FORM) is a spacing presentation form that does not compose and does not raise the ink ceiling. U+064D (combining kasratan) - what a keyboard actually produces - is placed ABOVE the shadda on all four bases tested. See DIACRITIC_QA.png and report section 12.

knownIssuesInspected.title: English letter i not displaying (Office 2013, Windows 10)
knownIssuesInspected.finding: Does not reproduce in Chrome/HarfBuzz. U+0069 carries a 25.31px advance at 100px and its tittle sits at 0.7074 em; 'Confidence' measures exactly that much wider than 'Confdence'. Appears to be a legacy-shaper problem specific to that application, not a defect in the font data.
